sources.title: Rare earth export curbs rattle magnet supply chains
sources.lead: Manufacturers warned that newly announced export curbs on rare earth oxides could constrain magnet production within two quarters.

sources.title: Magnet shortage scenarios priced into motor suppliers
sources.lead: Equity analysts modelled three shortage scenarios for permanent magnet availability and revised margin forecasts for motor suppliers.
